name: dokidlc
description: DaftDoki's plugins for the agents in ~/Code/agents: questlog, memory, unslop, and writing-for-agents.

plugins.name: questlog
plugins.description: Quests and chores through one flat machine of states, with creator review

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: A per-agent memory in the memoryfield format, searched semantically, with suspicion instead of expiry

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Cut AI tells from any writing. pstack lineage with the soul section and model invocation kept; puts itself in context at session and subagent start

plugins.name: writing-for-agents
plugins.description: Writing documents for agents: skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and any document an agent reads. Matt Pocock's skill, vendored
